svg.aria-label: Flagship systems: LexGuard: Reviews contracts under Indian law. Written rules can overrule the model.; Pikina: A local assistant that asks before it acts, and can undo what it did.; Noesis: Searches video, audio, PDFs and images. Every answer points to a second or a page.; Mobius: Subscription billing where the database itself refuses to bill twice.; BenchShield: Finds where AI benchmark answers leaked online, and proves every finding with evidence.; HostelDesk: Hostel complaints with honest ETAs, automatic routing and escalation. Live on Vercel.
